name: Broken Hill Hospital
scope: Standing main Broken Hill Base Hospital at 176 Thomas Street, including the connected ward and treatment wings, six open courtyards, main foyer and rear Emergency Department access.
era: Standing hospital, opened in 2000 with later alterations

review.notes: The published Qualla candidate shows the demolished predecessor and has an unidentified creator. The standing hospital uses no reference imagery. Native vector mapping and the city, operator, builder and planning records establish the present outline, principal materials and entrance arrangement.
